entries.en: The remains deporalize you temporaly.
entries.translated: I resti ti deporalizzano temporaneamente.

entries.en: With the power of the dark Custodian still holding away, the fog is keeping you from entering Quaid's den.
entries.translated: Con il potere del Custode oscuro ancora in agguato, la nebbia ti impedisce di entrare nella tana di Quaid.

entries.en: You have completed the food offering ritual!
entries.translated: Hai completato il rituale dell'offerta del cibo!

entries.en: You must wait. Someone is challenging
entries.translated: Devi aspettare. Qualcuno è impegnativo

entries.en: The turtle is hungry... You must feed it.
entries.translated: La tartaruga ha fame... Devi darle da mangiare.

entries.en: Access granted!
entries.translated: Accesso concesso!

entries.en: You have to master the challenge first!
entries.translated: Devi prima padroneggiare la sfida!

entries.en: You have to master this very last challenge within 5 minutes!
entries.translated: Devi superare quest'ultima sfida entro 5 minuti!

entries.en: Achoo! You spill the pollen into your bag.
entries.translated: Achoo! Versa il polline nella borsa.

entries.en: You collected the smelly pollen into a bag.
entries.translated: Hai raccolto il polline puzzolente in un sacchetto.

entries.en: <clong!> <clong!> There This piece fixed.
entries.translated: <clong!> <clong!> Ecco questo pezzo riparato.

entries.en: This mission stinks ... and now you do as well!
entries.translated: Questa missione fa schifo... e ora fai schifo anche tu!

entries.en: You carefully gather the quara ink
entries.translated: Raccogli con cura l'inchiostro di quara

entries.en: You carefully gather the stalker blood.
entries.translated: Raccogli attentamente il sangue dello stalker.

entries.en: %s damaged the shadow nexus! You can't damage it while it's burning.
entries.translated: %s ha danneggiato il nesso d'ombra! Non puoi danneggiarlo mentre brucia.
